records.tr.scope: The present document reports the RAN1 aspects of the study item “Study on 6G Radio” [2].

The study on physical layer use cases captured in [5] shows potentials for AI/ML algorithm in cellular communication system. Further study on using AI/ML for UE mobility in NR was hence conducted in this study item. This study explores RRM measurement and measurement event prediction mainly in temporal domain (FR1 for case B and FR2 for case A) and frequency domain (FR1) to understand the feasibility and performance of using AI/ML algorithm for enabling measurement reduction or handover performance improvement based on simulation evaluation. Analysis on specification impact is carried out for both UE sided model and network sided model for said scenarios.

records.scope: The present document provides the description and investigation of new AI/ML based use cases, i.e., Network Slicing and Coverage and Capacity Optimization, and its corresponding solutions, and initial analysis of Rel-18 leftovers.
